prompt:
Warm painterly digital illustration of a real Indian home kitchen, matching the soft, flat-shaded storybook illustration style, brushwork and lighting of the reference image. Wide landscape composition. The left 42% of the frame is an empty, smooth deep olive-green wall (#3f4229) with nothing on it, gently vignetted, reserved for text. The kitchen scene occupies the right side on a light wooden counter in front of a cream tiled wall with a small window. Palette: olive and forest green, warm wood, turmeric orange, steel grey, cream. No people, no text, no lettering, no logos, no brand marks.
Time of day: evening. The window shows a dusky indigo sky; a warm pendant lamp glows over the counter casting cozy amber light. On the counter and a two-burner stove: a kadai with gently steaming aloo gobi, a stainless-steel pressure cooker, a rolling board with a few rotis and a rolling pin, a round steel masala dabba with turmeric, red chilli and cumin, a whole cauliflower and potatoes, a sprig of coriander.
